title: F.TEST and FTEST: an identity decomposition and two single-row ULP witnesses
status_plain: F.TEST decomposes exactly as twice FDIST at the ratio of the larger to the smaller unbiased variance, proven on three live two-sample sets. One of the three matched at a statistic offset of -1 ULP, isolating a variance-accumulation-order detail that remains open. As with G3-05 this is Excel-against-Excel identity work with no pass rate, and the inheritance claim is causal. The only per-surface measurements are two tracked recon rows at 1 ULP each.
